stories.title: VinFast beats earnings estimates by $0.05, revenue tops forecasts
stories.summary: VinFast reported quarterly results ahead of analyst estimates, with earnings per share beating by $0.05 and revenue also topping expectations. The report is a rare beat for the Vietnamese EV maker, which has faced scrutiny over its path to profitability.
stories.whyItMatters: A beat gives some support to VinFast's growth story at a time when EV makers outside the top tier face pressure on margins and demand.
whatToWatch: Management commentary on delivery targets and cash burn
Analyst reaction and any estimate revisions
questions: Was the beat driven by volume, pricing, or cost cuts?
Does the company reaffirm full-year guidance?

stories.title: Saudi Arabia raises alarm as Yemen fighting threatens key oil shipping routes
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has sounded alerts over fighting in Yemen that puts important oil shipping routes under pressure, according to a report. The development raises the risk of disruption to tanker traffic in a strategically sensitive corridor.
stories.whyItMatters: Threats to Middle East shipping lanes can quickly move oil prices and add a geopolitical risk premium across energy and freight markets.
whatToWatch: Any escalation in Yemen fighting near shipping lanes
Oil price reaction and tanker insurance costs
Saudi or allied statements on route security
questions: How close is the fighting to actual shipping lanes versus onshore areas?
Have any vessels or routes actually been disrupted yet?

stories.title: UBS lifts AI capex forecast to nearly $1 trillion this year, $1.4 trillion by 2027
stories.summary: UBS now expects global AI capital expenditure to reach almost $1 trillion in 2026 and climb to around $1.4 trillion by 2027, according to a report. The upgraded forecast points to continued heavy spending by hyperscalers and chipmakers on AI infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: AI capex forecasts are a key driver of sentiment toward chipmakers, cloud providers, and the broader tech-led rally, so an upward revision supports the bull case for that group.
whatToWatch: Capex guidance from major hyperscalers in coming earnings reports
Chipmaker order trends and lead times
questions: What is driving UBS's upward revision from prior estimates?
How concentrated is this spending among a handful of companies?

sources.title: UBS now expects AI capex to reach nearly $1tn this year and around $1.4tn by 2027

stories.title: Gold and silver hit weekly highs as inflation concerns ease
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices climbed to weekly highs on Friday, September 18, with reports attributing the move to fading inflation concerns. Silver recovered quickly to join gold's rally to the top of its weekly range.
stories.whyItMatters: Precious metals often move on shifting inflation and rate expectations, so a joint rally in gold and silver points to investors recalibrating their outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether the rally extends into next week
Upcoming inflation data and Fed commentary that could confirm or reverse the move
questions: What specifically eased inflation concerns this week?
